No committed root Cargo.lock. Codec codegen/runtime reserve only; requires frozen dependency resolution, Windows pilot and agreed test inputs before inclusion.

measurement.cold_definition: Empty unique target directory, not an OS page-cache flush. No network in timed commands.
measurement.incremental_definition: Fresh unique target seeded by the identical compiler, environment and command outside timing. No-op expects zero rebuilt artifacts; comment edit expects at least one. Neither is a semantic-edit or compiler-cache-hit guarantee.
measurement.edit: Append one Rust comment to the exact tracked source_edit file; restore original bytes in finally. Baseline revision/clean tree and lock hash are required before and after.
measurement.cpu: Total command process-tree CPU, including Cargo, rustc, linker and build scripts; not rustc-only CPU.
measurement.memory: Fresh Windows Job Object per command: peak aggregate committed Job memory and largest process committed-memory peak. Not RSS, not sum of process peaks. Existing shared-session peaks are cumulative and cannot be differenced.
measurement.runtime: Unfiltered selected correctness commands are outside the compile clock. Runtime throughput/latency and output code size are not implemented or measured here.

proposed_design.approval: Maintainer agreement required before any study; no numerical performance/runtime/size acceptance thresholds selected by this preparation.
proposed_design.order: Counterbalanced variants by VM and round, reversing alternate rounds; same project/scenario order for all variants within a paired block.
proposed_design.aggregation: Report every project/scenario and contrast. For each family separately, average rounds within VM, compute candidate/control ratios, then equal-project geometric mean (1/3 each) and paired whole-VM bootstrap intervals. No combined full/incremental headline; no reserve or IronRDP weight in the new-root aggregate.
proposed_design.uncertainty: 10000 whole-VM paired draws, seed 1012026, 95% pointwise percentile intervals; retain all project/variant/scenario rows together. Fixed-artifact conditional inference, not retraining uncertainty.
proposed_design.exclusions: Only preregistered warmups excluded. Reject incomplete/failed matrices; retain failures and all regressions. No slow-sample trimming or post-result corpus selection.
proposed_design.pilot: After dependencies and coordination, one new standard x64 VM, one round, initially fd full-check plus both incremental scenarios for every qualified variant. Correctness outside timing. Pilot is not broad qualification.
